skin.tagline: Collagen's raw material, released over 8 hours
skin.taglineZh: 胶原蛋白的原料，8小时缓释
skin.advantage: Skin cannot build collagen without vitamin C. The 8-hour extended release keeps blood levels steady all day instead of spiking and flushing out.
skin.advantageZh: 没有维C，皮肤无法合成胶原蛋白。8小时缓释让血液浓度全天平稳，而不是快速吸收又排出。
skin.who: Anyone working on acne marks, dull skin, or slow skin recovery. Works from the inside while your topical routine works outside.
skin.whoZh: 在意痘印、暗沉或皮肤恢复慢的人。内服支持，配合外用护肤。

immunity.tagline: Steady immune support your body can't store
immunity.taglineZh: 身体存不住的维C，全天稳定供给
immunity.advantage: Immune cells consume vitamin C rapidly and the body cannot store it. Extended release maintains supply through the whole day from acerola cherries, not synthetic ascorbic acid alone.
immunity.advantageZh: 免疫细胞快速消耗维C，而身体无法储存。缓释配方全天维持供给，原料来自针叶樱桃而非纯合成。
immunity.who: People who catch whatever is going around the office, frequent travelers, high-stress schedules.
immunity.whoZh: 办公室流行什么就中什么的人、经常出差的人、高压人群。

aging.tagline: The antioxidant collagen production depends on
aging.taglineZh: 胶原蛋白合成离不开的抗氧化剂
aging.advantage: Collagen production declines with age and vitamin C is required for every step of it. Steady 8-hour release supports daily repair against daily oxidative wear.
aging.advantageZh: 胶原蛋白合成随年龄下降，而每一步都需要维C。8小时缓释支持每日修复，对抗每日氧化损耗。
aging.who: Anyone 30+ starting to think about skin elasticity and daily antioxidant coverage.
aging.whoZh: 30岁以上、开始在意皮肤弹性和每日抗氧化储备的人。

skin.tagline: Omega-3 supports the skin barrier from within
skin.advantage: The skin barrier is built from fats. Steady omega-3 intake is commonly associated with a calmer, better-hydrated barrier; modern diets skew heavily to omega-6.
skin.advantageZh: 皮肤屏障由脂质构成。稳定摄入Omega-3与更稳定、更水润的屏障相关，而现代饮食普遍偏向Omega-6。
skin.who: Dry, easily irritated, or breakout-prone skin, especially if you rarely eat fatty fish.
skin.whoZh: 皮肤干燥、易泛红或易爆痘的人，尤其是很少吃深海鱼的人。

skin.tagline: The gut-skin axis: calmer gut, calmer skin
skin.advantage: Research keeps linking gut microbiome balance with skin condition (the gut-skin axis). 6.3 billion CFU of clinically studied strains support that balance daily.
skin.advantageZh: 越来越多研究将肠道菌群平衡与皮肤状态联系起来（肠皮轴）。63亿临床研究菌株每日支持这种平衡。
skin.who: Recurring breakouts that topicals alone never quite resolve, especially alongside bloating or irregular digestion.
skin.whoZh: 反复长痘、光靠外用总解决不彻底的人，尤其伴随胀气或消化不规律。

immunity.tagline: 70% of immune tissue lines the gut
immunity.advantage: The largest immune organ is the gut lining. Supporting the microbiome with clinically studied strains supports the immune system where most of it lives.
immunity.advantageZh: 人体最大的免疫器官就是肠道。用临床研究菌株支持菌群，就是在免疫系统的主场支持它。
immunity.who: Frequent colds plus digestive ups and downs, the combination is often connected.
immunity.whoZh: 经常感冒又肠胃时好时坏的人，这两件事常常相关。

skin.tagline: Salicylic acid spot treatment, works overnight
skin.advantage: 2% salicylic acid clears pores right at the spot, the go-to active for breakouts, without drying the whole face.
skin.advantageZh: 2%水杨酸直接点涂疏通毛孔，祛痘经典成分，不干燥全脸。
skin.who: Sudden breakouts before events, teens and adults with occasional spots rather than full-face acne.
skin.whoZh: 重要场合前突然爆痘的人；偶发性痘痘而非全脸痤疮的青少年和成人。

skin.tagline: Deep-clean mask for congested, oily skin
skin.taglineZh: 深层清洁面膜，油痘肌友好
skin.advantage: Draws out impurities and excess oil from congested pores, the weekly reset that keeps daily breakouts down.
skin.advantageZh: 吸附毛孔内的油脂与杂质，每周一次的深层重置，减少日常爆痘。
skin.who: Oily and combination skin with blackheads or frequent clogged pores.
skin.whoZh: 有黑头、毛孔易堵的油性和混合性肌肤。

immunity.tagline: The sunshine vitamin most people are low on
immunity.taglineZh: 大多数人都缺的阳光维生素
immunity.advantage: Vitamin D helps regulate immune response, and indoor lifestyles leave most people below optimal levels most of the year.
immunity.advantageZh: 维D参与调节免疫反应，而室内生活方式让大多数人一年大部分时间都低于理想水平。
immunity.who: Office workers, northern winters, anyone who wears sunscreen daily (which blocks vitamin D synthesis).
immunity.whoZh: 办公室人群、日照少的季节、每天涂防晒的人（防晒会阻断维D合成）。

energy.tagline: The coenzymes that turn food into energy
energy.taglineZh: 把食物变成能量的辅酶
energy.advantage: B vitamins are the coenzymes of energy metabolism; without them food does not convert efficiently. Dual-action formula pairs instant and slow-release B, and one bottle lasts 4 months.
energy.advantageZh: B族是能量代谢的辅酶，缺了它食物无法高效转化为能量。双效配方兼顾速释与缓释，一瓶可用4个月。
energy.who: Afternoon crashes, coffee-dependent mornings, high-carb diets that burn through B vitamins faster.
energy.whoZh: 下午断电、早上靠咖啡续命、高碳水饮食（消耗B族更快）的人。

energy.tagline: Cover every micronutrient gap in one strip
energy.taglineZh: 一条补齐所有微量营养缺口
energy.advantage: Persistent low energy often traces to multiple small nutrient gaps rather than one. 22 vitamins and minerals plus 22 plant concentrates cover the full base.
energy.advantageZh: 长期没精神往往源于多个小缺口叠加，而不是缺某一种。22种维生素矿物质+22种植物浓缩，一次补齐地基。
energy.who: Busy people who eat irregularly and want one comprehensive daily habit instead of five bottles.
energy.whoZh: 吃饭不规律、想用一个习惯代替五瓶补充剂的忙碌人群。

energy.tagline: Steady blood sugar starts with morning protein
energy.taglineZh: 早晨蛋白质，血糖稳一天
energy.advantage: A carb-only breakfast sets up a blood sugar rollercoaster that crashes mid-morning. 21g of plant protein at breakfast keeps energy release steady.
energy.advantageZh: 纯碳水早餐让血糖坐过山车，上午十点就崩。早餐21克植物蛋白让能量平稳释放。
energy.who: People who skip breakfast or grab pastries, then wonder why energy dips before lunch.
energy.whoZh: 不吃早餐或随手面包解决、然后纳闷为什么午饭前就没电的人。

muscle.tagline: 21g organic protein for the rebuild window
muscle.advantage: Muscle grows during recovery, not during the workout. Tri-plant blend (pea, rice, chia) delivers a complete amino acid profile without dairy bloating.
muscle.advantageZh: 肌肉是在恢复中生长的，不是在训练中。三重植物配方（豌豆+糙米+奇亚籽）氨基酸完整，无乳制品胀气。
muscle.who: Lifters who bloat on whey, plant-based athletes, and anyone under-eating protein on busy days.
muscle.whoZh: 喝乳清胀气的健身人群、素食运动员，以及忙起来蛋白质摄入不够的人。

weight.tagline: Protein keeps you full, fullness keeps you on plan
weight.taglineZh: 蛋白质饱腹，饱腹才守得住计划
weight.advantage: Protein is the most satiating macronutrient. Replacing a carb-heavy meal or snack with 21g of plant protein reduces the cravings that break diets.
weight.advantageZh: 蛋白质是饱腹感最强的营养素。用21克植物蛋白替换高碳水一餐或零食，减少击垮计划的馋嘴时刻。
weight.who: Anyone managing weight who gets derailed by afternoon or late-night snacking.
weight.whoZh: 正在管理体重、但总被下午或夜宵零食带偏的人。

sleep.tagline: The relaxation mineral stress burns through
sleep.taglineZh: 压力最先消耗的放松矿物质
sleep.advantage: Magnesium supports muscle relaxation and nervous system wind-down, and it is exactly what sustained stress depletes fastest. Evening timing works best.
sleep.advantageZh: 镁支持肌肉放松与神经系统的平静，恰恰是持续压力消耗最快的矿物质。晚间服用效果最好。
sleep.who: Wired-but-tired at bedtime, muscle tension, restless legs, or nighttime cramps.
sleep.whoZh: 身体累但大脑停不下来、肌肉紧绷、腿不安或夜间抽筋的人。

sleep.taglineZh: 植物配方助睡，不靠褪黑素
sleep.advantage: Calming botanicals support the natural wind-down process instead of forcing sleep with melatonin, so there is no groggy morning or dependency pattern.
sleep.advantageZh: 舒缓植物配方支持身体自然的入睡过程，而不是用褪黑素强行催睡，早上不昏沉、不依赖。
sleep.who: Trouble falling asleep from a busy mind; people who dislike how melatonin makes them feel next morning.
sleep.whoZh: 思绪多难入睡的人；不喜欢褪黑素第二天昏沉感的人。

sleep.advantage: Calcium and magnesium taken in the evening support muscle relaxation and the nervous system's shift into rest mode.
sleep.advantageZh: 晚间补充钙镁，支持肌肉放松和神经系统切换到休息模式。
sleep.who: Light sleepers who wake at small noises, and anyone with evening muscle tightness.
sleep.whoZh: 睡得浅、一点动静就醒的人，以及晚间肌肉紧绷的人。

muscle.advantage: Fast-absorbing whey right after training hits the recovery window when muscles are most receptive. Grass-fed source, tested for banned substances.
muscle.advantageZh: 训练后快速吸收的乳清蛋白，正好赶上肌肉最需要营养的恢复窗口。草饲奶源，禁药检测。
muscle.who: Regular gym-goers optimizing post-workout nutrition; athletes who need tested supplements.
muscle.whoZh: 规律健身、重视练后营养的人；需要检测认证补剂的运动员。

weight.tagline: 30-day program: 70% of committed users lost weight
weight.advantage: Not a crash diet, a 30-day habit reset covering food, water, movement and mindfulness, with gut-supporting products and an app to track it. In Amway's study, 70% of committed participants lost weight.
weight.advantageZh: 不是极端节食，而是覆盖饮食、饮水、运动、正念的30天习惯重置，配合肠道支持产品和打卡App。官方研究中70%坚持者体重下降。
weight.who: People who have tried diets that work for two weeks then collapse; anyone who wants structure and tracking.
weight.whoZh: 试过各种饮食法、坚持两周就崩的人；想要结构化计划和打卡追踪的人。

hair.tagline: Biotin + collagen: feed hair from the root
hair.taglineZh: 生物素+胶原：从发根养发
hair.advantage: Hair is built from protein and depends on biotin, collagen and silicon supply. Topical products coat the strand; nutrition feeds the follicle where growth actually happens.
hair.advantageZh: 头发由蛋白质构成，依赖生物素、胶原和硅的供给。外用产品只能护发丝，营养才能滋养真正长发的毛囊。
hair.who: Thinning, shedding, or brittle hair and nails, especially after stress periods or dieting.
hair.whoZh: 头发变稀、掉发、发甲易断的人，尤其在高压期或节食后。

hair.tagline: Reset an oily scalp so follicles can breathe
hair.taglineZh: 重置油性头皮，让毛囊呼吸
hair.advantage: Buildup and excess scalp oil suffocate follicles. Deep-cleansing without sulfate harshness keeps the scalp environment healthy for growth.
hair.advantageZh: 油脂和残留堆积会闷住毛囊。无硫酸盐刺激的深层清洁，维持适合生长的头皮环境。
hair.who: Oily scalp, flat hair by mid-day, or product buildup from styling.
hair.whoZh: 头皮出油快、到中午头发就塌、造型产品残留多的人。

aging.tagline: Classic antioxidant protection for cell membranes
aging.taglineZh: 经典抗氧化，保护细胞膜
aging.advantage: Vitamin E sits in cell membranes intercepting oxidative damage where it happens. Paired with lecithin for absorption, in a chewable format.
aging.advantageZh: 维E驻守在细胞膜上，在损伤发生处拦截氧化。搭配卵磷脂助吸收，咀嚼型好入口。
aging.who: Adults building a long-term antioxidant base, often paired with vitamin C and omega-3.
aging.whoZh: 在搭建长期抗氧化基础的成年人，常与维C、鱼油搭配。

aging.tagline: Peptide renewal routine in one set
aging.advantage: The complete renewing routine, cleanse, treat, protect, built around peptides that support skin's own renewal cycle, in one decision instead of three.
aging.advantageZh: 完整焕新流程：清洁、修护、防护。围绕支持皮肤自身更新周期的胜肽配方，一次搭齐不用选三次。
aging.who: First fine lines, loss of glow, or anyone ready to upgrade from basic moisturizer to a real routine.
aging.whoZh: 刚出现细纹、皮肤失去光泽的人，或准备从基础保湿升级到完整流程的人。
